دَمَارٌ , (S, A, Msb,) a simple subst., (Msb,) and ↓ دَمَارَةٌ (MF, TA) and ↓ دُمُورٌ , (MF, [but see 1,]) Perdition: (S, A, Msb, &c.:) or utter perdition. (TA.) You say, حَلَّ بِهِمُ الدَّمَارُ Perdition [or
utter perdition] befell them. (A.) And مَارَأَيْتَ وَدَبَارَتِهِ ↓ مِنْ خَسَارَتِهِ وَدَمَارَتِهِ [What sawest thou of his error and his perdition and his state of destruction?]. (T.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
